author: Claude (draft for owner approval)
status: PROPOSAL, not approved. Covers only the 37 Road-to-100 players; the 63 ratings-v1.1 players are unchanged and not included.
method: Same as ratings-v1.1: editorial peak-career judgments, rated directly on the final v1.1 scale (composure already in stretched units) and anchored player by player to approved v1.1 comparables. Not derived by formula from base ratings; no match simulations consulted. Intended to replace the formula output of tools/extend-roster-ratings.cjs.

sergio-ramos.rationale: Aggressive front-foot defender with big-moment calm; positional lapses and rash dives keep his reading below the elite readers.

alessandro-nesta.rationale: Clean, anticipating defender of the highest class; graceful and quick across the ground.

fabio-cannavaro.rationale: Small, explosive, superb timing; agility is his signature for a centre-back.

carles-puyol.rationale: Ferocious work rate and recovery running; more duel-winner than reader; adequate on the ball.

virgil-van-dijk.rationale: Unhurried positional defender who rarely needs to tackle; famously calm; conserves energy rather than presses.

john-terry.rationale: Elite organiser and reader; slow on the turn; composed in his own box.

philipp-lahm.rationale: Intelligent, near-errorless full-back and holder; reads play exceptionally; calm and nimble.

cafu.rationale: Tireless overlapping runner; defensive positioning good, not elite.

roberto-carlos.rationale: Explosive athlete with huge stamina; famously left space behind; decisions sometimes rushed.

franz-beckenbauer.rationale: The libero: read the game in advance and played out with total calm; did not need to chase.

vincent-kompany.rationale: Commanding, intelligent leader; recurring injuries cap stamina.

ashley-cole.rationale: Quick, disciplined full-back; outstanding one-v-one reading for a wide defender.

gennaro-gattuso.rationale: Relentless harrier; snapping pursuit over anticipation; simple and sometimes hurried on the ball.

xavi-hernandez.rationale: Metronome who almost never lost the ball under pressure; pressed hard within a collective system; limited defensive reading.

andres-iniesta.rationale: Elusive turn and glide in tight space; ice-calm decisions; little defensive role.

luka-modric.rationale: Industrious technician with a long peak; nimble, press-resistant, useful defensive cover.

toni-kroos.rationale: Supremely calm distributor; not quick; positional rather than pressing.

andrea-pirlo.rationale: Deep regista with total calm; did not press or run; read passing lanes adequately.

sergio-busquets.rationale: Benchmark positional screen; intercepts by anticipation and escapes pressure with minimal touches; not quick.

kaka.rationale: Devastating acceleration on the carry; calm finisher; limited defensive work.

david-beckham.rationale: Covered huge distances; composed technician; not an agile dribbler (setPiece flag candidate).

cesc-fabregas.rationale: Precocious playmaker, calm in possession; average reading and pressing.

bastian-schweinsteiger.rationale: Matured into a complete, composed holder with good reading; not nimble.

clarence-seedorf.rationale: Powerful, balanced and unflappable; moderate defensive reading.

mesut-ozil.rationale: Gliding creator, calm on the ball; minimal pressing or defending.

lionel-messi.rationale: Unmatched balance and turn in tight space; ice-calm; walked off the ball by design.

cristiano-ronaldo.rationale: Elite athlete with exceptional durability; big-moment calm; little defensive work.

neymar.rationale: Elastic dribbler; decisions sometimes theatrical; modest tracking.

kylian-mbappe.rationale: Explosive acceleration; cool finisher; minimal defending.

thierry-henry.rationale: Fluid acceleration and balance; famously composed one-v-one; selective pressing.

wayne-rooney.rationale: Tireless, combative forward who tracked back; temperament occasionally rushed his decisions.

luis-suarez.rationale: Relentless presser and wriggling dribbler; volatile temperament.

robert-lewandowski.rationale: Clinical, unhurried penalty-box forward; works the line; little defending.

karim-benzema.rationale: Elegant link forward with great calm; moderate pressing.

didier-drogba.rationale: Power forward and big-game player; strong rather than nimble.

samuel-etoo.rationale: Sharp, quick finisher who also worked as a wide defender for Inter.

mohamed-salah.rationale: Rapid and nimble; strong durability; limited defensive role.
